subject: alebrije
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: alebrije jaguar-eagle.
Style: Oaxacan alebrije painted wood.

spec.name: Alebrije Jaguar-Eagle
spec.description: A chunky painted-wood Oaxacan alebrije: a jaguar's body, legs and tail carrying an eagle's hooked-beak head and two spread feathered wings, covered in rosettes, dot rings, zigzag bands and swirls in saturated flat colours.
spec.layout:
Rest pose, centred on x=0, facing +Z, on four jaguar paws on y=0. Spans z from -1.65 (tail plume) to 1.65 (beak tip), x ±1.8 (wing tips), y 0 to 2.1 (head crest). Front to back: hooked eagle beak (z 1.1 to 1.6), round skull with big amber eyes and a feather crest, a thick raised neck with a feather ruff rising from the chest at z 0.5, a deep-chested jaguar torso (chest z 0.3, waist z -0.1, hips z -0.55) with two wings at the shoulders (spread sideways, rising slightly, feathers trailing backward), four sturdy short legs with oversized paws, and a thick tail running back at z -0.85 that curls up into a fan of eyed feathers.

Style: carved and painted wood. Chunky, simple, faceted shapes (low segment counts, 6 to 10 sides) with painted ornament built as small parts in their own flat colours, seated on the surface. Every part uses the same motifs so the model reads as one hand-painted piece:
(1) Rosette: a ring of 5 to 6 small magenta or blue discs round a turquoise centre disc, on a black outline disc, on the orange coat.
(2) Dot rows: cream dots, sometimes with a black ring under them, in lines along edges and bands.
(3) Zigzag or triangle bands in alternating colours.
(4) Teardrop or leaf shapes in green and pink.
(5) Thin ink-black swirls and outlines (inkBlack) under coloured shapes, so each coloured shape has a dark outline layer, then the colour, then a small cream highlight dot.
Colour goes by place: the coat is warm orange and yellow on top, cream underneath, with blue and violet shadow areas. Head and wings are turquoise, magenta and yellow. Paws and beak are bright yellow. Bare unpainted wood (woodBare) appears only on the claw tips, the underside of the paw pads and a few carved ridge edges. No ground, base or props.

parts.builds: The jaguar body and its painted decoration. One smooth loft (bone: hips, spine, chest) from z -0.85 to 0.6. Stations: hips (z -0.55, width 0.62, height 0.58, centre y 1.0), waist (z -0.1, width 0.5, height 0.52, y 1.03), chest (z 0.3, width 0.68, height 0.7, y 1.08), chest front (z 0.58, width 0.5, height 0.55, y 1.1), round-capped so the head part's neck sweeps from neckBase into it. Coat: coatOrange on top and sides with a coatYellow upper flank, and a cream belly stripe on the underside (use sectors or a countershade paint). A deepBlue saddle stripe along the spine from z 0.4 to -0.7, edged with cream dot rows and magenta triangle (zigzag) trim on both edges, with a row of small carved ridge studs (gold) on spineTop. 12 to 16 jaguar rosettes on each flank (rosette motif: black outline disc, ring of 5 to 6 magenta or deepBlue dots, turquoise centre), scattered with minDist, kept off the belly and clear of the leg and wing mounts. Zigzag bands in violet and skyBlue across the belly. A collar of leaf shapes (leafGreen and lime teardrops) with cream dots round the chest at z 0.5, under the neck. A magenta swirl line sweeping from each shoulder across the flank. Small hip rosettes and a ring of dots at each hip socket and shoulder socket, where the legs meet the body.
parts.attaches: Owns hips, spine and chest. Neck and head start at neckBase and chestFront. Wings mount at shoulderL and shoulderR on the upper sides. The foreleg tops mount at foreShoulderL/R and the hind tops at hindHipL/R. The tail starts at tailRoot.

parts.builds: The eagle neck, head and face. The neck is one thick sweep over neck1, neck2 and head from neckBase to the skull (radius about 0.24 tapering to 0.2), painted turquoise, with a ruff of overlapping feather blades (broad, shaped, in rings round the neck from base to throat): inner ring cream, then yellow, then magenta, then violet tips, each outlined in inkBlack. Skull: a faceted sphere at headCentre (radius about 0.21) in turquoise, with a lighter skyBlue brow ridge over each eye. Eyes: big readable eyes on both sides at the front of the skull (x ±0.15, y 1.74, z 1.08): inkBlack outline disc, cream white disc, eyeAmber iris, black pupil, a tiny cream highlight, with a magenta feather-eyebrow blade above each. Beak: separate upper and lower. The upper beak (on head) is a thick hooked wedge or cone from beakRoot to z 1.6, curving down at the tip (y 1.58), beakYellow with a beakOrange cere at the base and two inkBlack nostril dots. The lower beak (on jaw) is a shorter wedge from the jawHinge to z 1.5, beakOrange, with a thin inkBlack gape line. A crest of 7 to 9 tall feather blades fanned on top and back of the skull rising to y 2.08, in a root-to-tip palette of magenta, yellow, lime, skyBlue, each with a cream dot at the tip. Cheek discs with a dot ring in pink and deepBlue, and a swirl painted down the neck sides.
parts.attaches: The neck starts at the mount neckBase, inside the torso's chest front (chestFront). The head sits at headCentre. The jaw hinges at jawHinge.

parts.builds: Both wings, left and right mirrored, spread sideways and slightly up, feathers trailing back. Each wing has a main arm tube (sweep over wingShoulder, wingElbow, wingWrist, wingTip, radius 0.1 tapering to 0.05) in magenta. Layers (the same on both sides, left x>0): (1) a leading-edge band of coverts, 3 overlapping rows of rounded feather shapes (extruded flat leaves) over the arm top and covering the arm to the wrist: row 1 coatYellow, row 2 turquoise, row 3 magenta, each with an inkBlack outline layer and a row of cream dots. (2) Secondaries (on the secondariesL/R fan joints): 8 broad feathers about 0.55 long trailing back from the elbow to the wrist, alternating skyBlue and deepBlue with violet tips, each with a cream eye-dot and black outline. (3) Primaries (on primariesL/R): 7 long feathers, 0.7 to 0.9 long, fanned outwards and back from the wrist, with colours cycling coatOrange, red, magenta, violet, leafGreen, lime, turquoise, a black stripe down the middle and a cream tip dot or zigzag. Wing tips reach about x ±1.8. A small thumb feather group near the wrist in lime. Flower-like rosette (dot ring) at the shoulder joint. Feathers are flat extruded blades with a slight bevel, spread in a ring or fan.
parts.attaches: Roots at shoulderL and shoulderR on the torso's upper sides (x ±0.3, y 1.3). Nothing touches the legs or the head. A clear gap above the back.

parts.builds: All four jaguar legs, built as sweeps or limb chains over the leg joints (left x>0, right mirrored). Short, thick, with big paws. Upper legs are about 0.15 radius tapering to 0.1; the front legs run straight down (shoulder, elbow, wrist, paw), the hind legs bend with the hock back (hip, knee forward, ankle back, paw). Paws touch y=0 at the foot mounts (footFL/FR/BL/BR), each about 0.12 radius, 0.3 long, in beakYellow, with three rounded toe bumps in front on each paw, and bright cream claw cones (woodBare tips) pointing forward and down, and a paw-pad underside in woodBare and inkBlack. Legs are coatOrange, ringed with bands: alternating turquoise, magenta and cream, each band bordered by inkBlack thin rings, at the elbow/knee and above the paw like painted socks, with rows of cream dots between the bands. Rosettes (dot ring motif) on each upper leg's outer side, and a swirl zigzag line in violet down the inside edge. Shoulder and hip balls (sphere caps) in coatYellow where the legs meet the torso at foreShoulder and hindHip.
parts.attaches: The leg tops sit inside the torso underside at foreShoulderL/R and hindHipL/R. The paws rest on y=0 at the foot mounts.

parts.builds: The jaguar tail and its plume. A tail sweep over tail1 to tail5 from tailRoot (radius 0.13 tapering to 0.07), running back at the waist height and curling up at the end to tailTip. Painted coatOrange with a black ring band every 0.12 m (inkBlack), and between them alternating turquoise and magenta zigzag bands and cream dot rows. At tailTip, a fan of 9 to 11 long feathers (flat extruded blades with a bevel, 0.4 to 0.5 long) on the plume joint, fanned in an arc round the tail tip, leaning up and back, in a peacock-like palette: leafGreen, turquoise, deepBlue with lime and violet. Each feather has an eye motif at the tip (an inkBlack oval, then a skyBlue oval, magenta oval, and a cream dot) and an inkBlack centre stripe. A thick tuft-like carved base cuff at tail5 in gold with small cream dots. Plus a small ridge row of 3 to 4 gold studs along the tail root.
parts.attaches: Starts at the mount tailRoot, inside the rear end of the torso (hips). The plume fan opens at tailTip.

calls.reasoning:
I'm designing a jaguar-eagle alebrije hybrid: a quadruped jaguar body with an eagle head and wings, finished in bright Oaxacan-style painted patterns with dots, swirls, and stripes. I'm working out proportions—roughly a 1.6m chunky stylized body plus spread wings—to keep it visually balanced.

I'm mapping the full layout along the z-axis: torso, four legs, a raised neck leading to the eagle head and hooked beak, a curling tail, and outstretched wings with feathered fans. I'm also sketching the joint hierarchy (hips, spine, neck, head/jaw, leg segments, tail segments, wing shoulders/elbows/wrists), making sure all joint names stay alphanumeric, and starting to break the model into parts beginning with the torso and head sections.

Still placing joint coordinates...

Planning out the joint chain for legs and wings, letting toes be simple attached parts rather than separate joints to keep things manageable. Counting up: spine, neck, head, and jaw joints plus four legs with four joints each gives 23, then adding wing joints for shoulder, elbow, wrist, and tip per wing along with feather groups.

Now I'm working through the feather hinges for secondaries and primaries on each wing, roughly 12 total, plus 5 tail joints, landing around 40 joints overall. I'm positioning the wing geometry -- shoulder, elbow, wrist, and primary feather tips -- adjusting coordinates so the wingspan reaches the target width while the primaries fan outward and back from the wrist.

I'm finalizing the overall bounding size at roughly 3.6 wide, 2.1 tall, 3.1 long, spanning from the tail tip to the beak, and now shaping the jaguar's tail with a curling, upward-rising sequence of joints toward the back.

Now I'm picking out the alebrije color palette — bare wood tones alongside vivid magenta, turquoise, and sun yellow for the decorative patterning.

I'm settling on beak and claw colors, cream-colored eyes with amber irises, and bare wood for the feet base, staying within a 24-color limit. Then I start designing the jaguar-inspired coat with an orange-yellow body and black rosette patterns.

Now I'm detailing the rosette structure—magenta outer rings with turquoise centers—plus dot patterns on the flanks, a cream zigzag belly, and a deep blue saddle stripe with white dots. I'm working out the head coloring in teal and magenta, feather bands on the wings in scalloped magenta/yellow coverts, turquoise secondaries, and alternating orange/red/violet primaries with black outlines, plus a peacock-like tail with eye dots and ring-banded legs with turquoise paws.

I'm mapping out the attachment points where body parts connect—neck base, shoulders, wing roots, tail root, hips—and defining the bounding boxes for the torso, neck/head, and wings to figure out how everything fits together spatially.

Now I'm working through joint ownership and parenting hierarchy: torso owns spine/hips/chest, head owns neck and jaw joints, with legs, wings, and tail each parented to the appropriate body segment (front legs and wings to chest, hind legs and tail to hips). I'm also starting to define the chest loft parameters like radius and height so the torso shape can match up with where the legs attach.

Defining joint positions and directions...

Still working out hind leg joints...

Now I'm mirroring the leg structure for the right side with negated X values, then moving to wing anatomy: shoulder, elbow, wrist, and tip joints with directional vectors, plus feather group attachments branching off the elbow.

Continuing the neck and head chain with a jaw hinge joint, then sketching the skull sphere, upper and lower beak geometry with the hook at the tip, and a crest rising above the head.

I'm setting floor contact only for legs, budgeting part complexity (torso 170, head 230, wings 220, legs 160, tail 110), and planning decorative motifs — dot rings, zigzag bands, teardrop leaves, black swirl outlines, and magenta-turquoise rosette patterns — to apply consistently across all parts.

Writing JSON structure...

I'm planning to build each leg by sweeping a path through the shoulder, elbow, wrist, and paw joint positions for both sides, using the existing joint definitions to position everything correctly.

Actually, simplifying to explicit per-segment capsules between joints is safer than a generic bone list, so I'm defining a helper that creates a rigid segment between two joints with a given radius and bone binding. I'm now working out the hind leg joint positions and building the paw as a scaled sphere with small toe bumps and forward-pointing claws.

Writing paw and segment code...

Defining more joint segments...
